G=[[1]*23 for _ in range(29)]

for r in range(14,23): G[r][10]=G[r][21]=3
G[23][10:22]=[3]*12
for r in [14,16,17]: G[r][13]=3

def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # isolated one-cell gaps in horizontal runs are marked red
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        for c in range(1,len(row)-1):
            if row[c] != row[0] and row[c-1]==row[c+1] and row[c-1]!=row[c]:
                # Only background-color interruption in a same-color run
                out[r][c]=2
    return out
R=transform(G)
print(R[13])
